title: Ruby Blocks & Items!
description: This project adds rubies to the game! It adds ruby ore, deesplate ruby ore, ruby block(s), and the ruby item itself!
body: This mod adds rubies to the game, which spawn naturally, though rarer than emeralds! Above the deepslate region, in caves, when mining, etc., you can find the ruby ore! At and under deepslate, you can find the NEW deepslate ruby ore! These ores can only be mined with a diamond and netherite pickaxe (the block can be mined with an iron pickaxe). See the gallery for the preview and more information! Go to the versions to download whichever 1.21 version you wish (from 1.21.3-1.21.11, and now from 26.1.2-26.2!). Updated to 26.1 and 26.2 in Quilt, Fabric, and Neoforge!
